facts.fact: DLA Piper Africa (IKM Advocates) states that the Business Laws (Amendment) Act, 2020 came into force on 18 March 2020 and allows advanced electronic signatures in place of wet-ink signatures in nearly all legal documents, amending among others the Law of Contract Act.

The article states that valid advanced electronic signatures are issued by certification service providers licensed under the Kenya Information and Communications (Electronic Certification and Domain Name Administration) Regulations 2020; it gives no making date, so the article date of 2020-10-21 is the latest it is known to exist.
facts.system: Kenya Information and Communications (Electronic Certification and Domain Name Administration) Regulations 2020

facts.fact: The article states that as at October 2020 only two certification service providers were licensed by the Communications Authority of Kenya, and neither had yet started issuing advanced electronic signatures.
facts.system: Certification service provider licensing under the 2020 Regulations

facts.fact: The article states that the Communications Authority issued a public notice on 1 September 2020 requiring all foreign electronic certification providers to apply for recognition within 30 days.
facts.system: Recognition of foreign certification providers under the 2020 Regulations
